must_verify: Record actual Ekstazi 5.3.0 artifact SHA256 and effective runtime configuration.
Cold baseline executes the entire known test universe and passes.
Warm unchanged baseline demonstrates active test selection.
Ordinary modified source with intact metadata executes the unchanged affected test.
Independent full-suite oracle exposes the intended assertion failure in the same modified source.
Test sources remain byte-identical across conditions.
Every scenario starts from an identical restored successful baseline.
Metadata absolute-path effects are controlled or separately documented.
No stale reports are counted as fresh test executions.
Native runs do not inherit metadata repaired by an earlier run or by the full-suite oracle.
Fault record names and target bytes are confined to the synthetic fixture.
Integrity reference resides outside the injected fault domain.
Integrity validation includes expected file inventory and recorded provenance.
Full-suite fallback is observed to execute rather than merely selected by a branch in code.
Missing measurements remain null or NA; failed setup is not an omission result.
Native observations under injected faults are labeled as controlled simulation findings.
Repeated identical runs are not counted as independent fault or project samples.
Repository plugin presence is separated from CI invocation and protection settings.

statistical_guidance.primary_unit: unique fixture + source modification + fault scenario
statistical_guidance.deterministic_repeats: repeatability only; do not inflate independent sample size
statistical_guidance.tiny_purposive_corpus: descriptive counts; no population prevalence inference
statistical_guidance.undefined_metrics: null or NA rather than zero or 100 percent
